protocol.cohort_rule: smallest SHA256(seed, NBA ID) among players with >=4 known 2025 windows and positive training PTS; frozen before development
protocol.history_policy: current season only; observed weeks only; minimum four own windows; next contiguous target
protocol.selection_metric: mean MAE divided by origin-known training mean for all eleven counts

scope: retrospective weekly counts; conditional on observed contiguous player-weeks
